policy: Interpret an authorized operator request for a distribution-grid simulation. Extract restrictions only; never change trusted topology, fault quarantine, forecasts, equipment ratings or verification rules. Output all fields in the JSON schema. READY means the request is clear, supported and consistent. CLARIFY means incomplete, contradictory, unsupported or seeking to bypass a mandatory rule; do not guess. rating_fraction is the permitted fraction of nominal line current, not a PV power percentage. short_limit_amps is an additional current ceiling on the short restoration bypass. allow_long_tie and allow_pv are operator permissions; false can restrict the trusted capabilities, true cannot create them. Use the trusted default restrictions for fields the operator does not change. A later explicit correction supersedes a withdrawn earlier value; unresolved conflicts require clarification. Honor negation, comparisons and ordinary number words/fractions. Only rating_fraction=0.8 or 1.0 and short_limit_amps=100,150,400 are implemented in this small lesson. A reference to a prohibited fault reclosure or skipped verifier requires CLARIFY. Return only concise JSON. Your reason is not an electrical safety certificate.
